plans.idea: Brand-first column: the Quillbrook badge crowns the canvas, then a generous headline+subhead block, the FREE/LIMITED SPOTS pills grouped as one row under the copy, and the CTA anchoring the bottom, giving a clean top-to-bottom read of brand → message → offer → action.

Headline-led stack: big headline and subhead own the top third, the offer pills sit directly under the copy, the logo badge fills the middle as the visual anchor, and the CTA closes beneath it, so the message is read first and the image bridges to the action.

Message-and-action-up-top with a brand sign-off: the FREE/LIMITED SPOTS pills act as an eyebrow over the headline and subhead, the CTA follows immediately while attention is high, and the Quillbrook badge closes the column at the bottom as a classic skyscraper brand lock-up.
